It uses an ordered dict as the LRU cache: hits move a key to most-recently-used, misses insert at MRU and evict the least-recently-used key when capacity is exceeded, appending evicted keys in order. Non-positive capacity yields all misses with empty cache/evictions and zero hits. Inputs are not mutated.
